# Common Foundry

> CMFD is a live GPU proof-of-work network. The GPU rental marketplace is in beta;
> customer-paid inference remains in development. Mining is separate from customer inference.

## Guides
- [Project status and getting started](https://commonfoundry.ai/learn/)
- [Mining](https://commonfoundry.ai/learn/mining/)
- [ForgeMatrix](https://commonfoundry.ai/learn/forgematrix/)
- [GPU rental beta](https://commonfoundry.ai/learn/gpu-renting/)
- [White paper publication context](https://commonfoundry.ai/docs/whitepaper/)
